name: NeNeTeePee-Stream-Kodi
description: Kodi 21 addon — stream Usenet via NZBHydra2 + nzbdav WebDAV. TMDBHelper player integration, PTT filtering, auto-updates via Kodi repository.

paragraphs: Current released packages (Stable 1.2.3 and Beta 2.0.0-beta.2) use the Kodi menu name NZB-DAV. In those builds, choose that name wherever these instructions show NeNeTeePee-Stream-Kodi. Renamed source builds use the new name.

A Kodi 21 (Omega) player/resolver add-on that streams Usenet media through TMDBHelper. You browse a movie or TV episode in TMDBHelper, NeNeTeePee-Stream-Kodi searches your indexers, you pick a release, and NeNeTeePee-Stream-Kodi streams it through nzbdav or InfiniDysk, with a progress bar, seeking, and automatic recovery when a source goes bad. No manual NZB handling required. An optional download-first NZBGet backend is also available.
This add-on provides software, not content. You bring your own indexers (NZBHydra2, Prowlarr, or direct Newznab), your own nzbdav, InfiniDysk, or NZBGet server, and your own Usenet provider.
features: Multi-provider search across NZBHydra2, Prowlarr, and direct Newznab
indexers, merged and de-duplicated. Optional TVDB-aware TV search resolves a show's id for more accurate episode results.
Quality filtering and ranking by resolution, HDR, audio, codec, language,

release group, size, and keywords. Default-enabled Other / Unknown options prevent unrecognized formats from disappearing. Relevance ranks resolution first, then HDR, Hybrid REMUX / REMUX, and three editable TRaSH remux…
Exact season-pack playback and reuse: completed multi-episode downloads
